card.name: Opening bracket after brand name ®
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis after a brand name and ® in drug lists, right before the maker's name. Also linking words in author funding statements about honoraria and consultancy fees.

modes.label: Maker bracket after brand
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a brand name with ® in a list of drugs, before the manufacturer.

modes.description: Linking or verb words in statements of speaking honoraria and consultancy fees from a company.
